commands: python tools/整套精听.py build YEAR --parts parts --original in/audio/原音.wav --out work
python tools/整套精听.py verify YEAR --parts parts --original in/audio/原音.wav --out work
optional_prepare: --prepare PATH（默认原音.wav同目录的原音准备.json）
required_parts_layout: parts/YEAR-{A,B1,B2}/meta.json + ASCII MP4 + evidence（严格当前child gate）
output: work/tem8-intensive-full-YEAR.mp4 + meta.json + verification.json + PCM重建核验.json + 组装命令.json
label: YEAR年 专八听力 精听.mp4
checks: all current child approvals, PNG digests and inputs
all source PCM samples + original native rate/channels
all video PTS and VCL bytes + exact parameter sets
whole and each part/body original PCM vs one final AAC
priming/effective audio PTS0, contiguous packets and chapter AV offsets
three chapter titles and order A→B1→B2
failure_policy: 任何失败不留下成功meta/verification；H264不兼容直接报错，不自动重编码画面。
